# ferentin_mcp_provider (Data Source)

Look up a global MCP provider by UUID. Read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ferentin_mcp_provider" "salesforce" {
  provider_id = "fbe4-..."
}

output "salesforce_slug" {
  value = data.ferentin_mcp_provider.salesforce.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) UUID of the catalog provider entry.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Catalog description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name shown in the admin console.
- `id` (String) Same as `provider_id` — surfaced as `id` per Terraform convention.
- `slug` (String) URL slug for the provider (e.g. `salesforce`, `box`).
